name: FairScan
tagline: Scan documents with your camera, simply and without the creepy extras
description:
FairScan turns your phone into a document scanner. Point your camera at a paper, receipt, or form, and it automatically detects the edges, cleans up the image, and saves it as a sharp PDF.

It's built to respect your privacy, with no accounts, no ads, and no tracking, just a fast, respectful way to digitize your paperwork.
